<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_MachineInspection" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/machine-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MachineInspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_InspectionBegin" name="Inspection requested"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineData" name="Enter machine type and serial number"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerQuestions" name="Answer inspection questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressMachineButtons" name="Press machine buttons"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectMachineValues" name="Collect and show machine values"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" name="Additional questions required?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" name="Answer additional questions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin" name="Inspection checks merged"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted" name="Inspection completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_InspectionBegin" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineData" targetRef="Task_AnswerQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_AnswerQuestions" targetRef="Task_PressMachineButtons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_PressMachineButtons" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CollectMachineValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired" name="Results require additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" targetRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${additionalQuestionsRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
